sentences.en: Don't worry, I also happen to be a financial consultant.
sentences.zh: 别担心，我恰好也是一名财务顾问。

sentences.en: The debate over which consultant to use went on for hours.
sentences.zh: 关于请哪位顾问的问题讨论了几个小时。

sentences.en: Seeing the briskly working toy consultants also left a strong impression.
sentences.zh: 看到那些忙碌工作的玩具顾问也给我留下了深刻的印象。

senses.zh: （受人咨询的）顾问,会诊医生，（顾问）医生,求教者，（与人）商议者，征求意见者，查阅者，咨询者
